about_short_description.short_description: ION Design is a product design and development firm specialized in product design, industrial design, product development, and innovation.

product.name: Innovation & Strategy
product.description: A service that uses tools like competitive analysis, IP evaluation, and innovation workshops to identify opportunities and generate new product concepts early in development.

product.name: Design Research & Human Factors
product.description: Research services including ethnographic studies, usability testing, and anthropometric analysis to inform product design focused on user interaction and ergonomics.

product.name: Industrial Design
product.description: A service that develops product concepts through sketches, models, CAD, and prototypes to define user experience and product aesthetics.

product.name: User Experience & UI Design
product.description: Design of user interfaces emphasizing intuitive navigation, visual hierarchy, and consistent graphical elements for software applications.

product.name: Engineering & Technology
product.description: Mechanical and electrical engineering services including CAD modeling, prototype fabrication, PCB design, firmware development, and technology integration for product realization.

product.name: Prototyping & Design for Manufacturing (DFM)
product.description: Creation of physical prototypes and optimization of designs for manufacturability to validate and prepare products for production.
